payload.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-26T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T08:38:04Z"
        AND user.name == "dev.dana"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                              message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other"),
           source.ip
| SORT failed DESC, accepted DESC

questions.q: In the row where last_seen is '2026-07-03T12:05:55.000Z', what is the value of accepted?
